schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS acp_scheduled_plans (
source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source IN ('web','desktop')),
schedule_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(schedule_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
definition_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(definition_json) AND json_type(definition_json)='object' AND length(CAST(definition_json AS BLOB))<=524288),
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
PRIMARY KEY(source,schedule_id)) STRICT;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS acp_scheduled_plans_insert_budget BEFORE INSERT ON acp_scheduled_plans
WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM acp_scheduled_plans WHERE source=NEW.source AND schedule_id=NEW.schedule_id)
AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acp_scheduled_plans)>=1000 OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(length(CAST(definition_json AS BLOB))),0) FROM acp_scheduled_plans)+length(CAST(NEW.definition_json AS BLOB))>33554432)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'ACP scheduled plan capacity exceeded'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS acp_scheduled_plans_update_budget BEFORE UPDATE ON acp_scheduled_plans
WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(length(CAST(definition_json AS BLOB))),0) FROM acp_scheduled_plans WHERE source!=OLD.source OR schedule_id!=OLD.schedule_id)+length(CAST(NEW.definition_json AS BLOB))>33554432
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'ACP scheduled plan capacity exceeded'); END;
read: SELECT * FROM acp_scheduled_plans WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=?
insert: INSERT INTO acp_scheduled_plans (source,schedule_id,definition_json,revision) VALUES (?,?,?,1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING *
update: UPDATE acp_scheduled_plans SET definition_json=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=? AND revision=? AND json_extract(definition_json,'$.projectId')=json_extract(?,'$.projectId') RETURNING *
delete: DELETE FROM acp_scheduled_plans WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=? AND revision=?
